title: Decision: Resolving `src/core/` → `application::` Upward Dependencies
summary: Approved Option A: move five pure value/error types into paladin-core, with application ports becoming thin re-exports, resolving core-to-application upward dependencies.
notes: Type held at DOC per MANIFEST_TYPE, but this document reads as an ADR: it has an explicit 'Chosen Option: A', 'Status: Approved', 'Decision Date: 2026-05-13', a Rationale section, and a Rejected Options section (Option B duplicate type hierarchies; Option C defer to Epic 2, fails FR-16). Downstream synthesizer note on the BattalionResult field-set question: this record does NOT settle any BattalionResult field set — it never mentions BattalionResult. It settles the *location* of PaladinResult (plus StopReason, TokenUsage, RegistryError, HandoffError), moving them into src/core/platform/container/execution_result.rs etc., with application ports as thin re-exports, and travelling to paladin-core in Task 5.0. Consequences recorded in source: zero breaking changes (existing paladin::application::ports::output::... paths resolve via re-exports); PaladinError deliberately excluded because it depends on GarrisonError in application::, and the 'pub use PaladinError' convenience re-export in herald.rs is removed; TaskPlan and HandoffRecord already in core so no circular dependency; implementation sub-tasks 3.6a-3.6k appended to the task list. Paired with a sibling '-options.md' document per the ingest prompt; that sibling was not read (out of assigned scope).
